Neural network initializers

Source: R/nn_initializers.R
nn_initializers.Rd

Ports of jax.nn.initializers. nn_initializers_zeros and nn_initializers_ones are initializers; the other functions build initializers. An initializer is a function init(key, shape, dtype = NULL, out_sharding = NULL) (the Initializer protocol of JAX) returning an array of the given shape and dtype (default float). Random initializers give the same values as JAX for the same key.

Usage

nn_initializers_zeros(key, shape, dtype = NULL, out_sharding = NULL)

nn_initializers_ones(key, shape, dtype = NULL, out_sharding = NULL)

nn_initializers_constant(value, dtype = NULL)

nn_initializers_uniform(scale = 0.01, dtype = NULL)

nn_initializers_normal(stddev = 0.01, dtype = NULL)

nn_initializers_truncated_normal(
  stddev = 0.01,
  dtype = NULL,
  lower = -2,
  upper = 2
)

nn_initializers_variance_scaling(
  scale,
  mode,
  distribution,
  in_axis = -2L,
  out_axis = -1L,
  batch_axis = integer(0),
  dtype = NULL
)

nn_initializers_glorot_uniform(
  in_axis = -2L,
  out_axis = -1L,
  batch_axis = integer(0),
  dtype = NULL
)

nn_initializers_xavier_uniform(
  in_axis = -2L,
  out_axis = -1L,
  batch_axis = integer(0),
  dtype = NULL
)

nn_initializers_glorot_normal(
  in_axis = -2L,
  out_axis = -1L,
  batch_axis = integer(0),
  dtype = NULL
)

nn_initializers_xavier_normal(
  in_axis = -2L,
  out_axis = -1L,
  batch_axis = integer(0),
  dtype = NULL
)

nn_initializers_lecun_uniform(
  in_axis = -2L,
  out_axis = -1L,
  batch_axis = integer(0),
  dtype = NULL
)

nn_initializers_lecun_normal(
  in_axis = -2L,
  out_axis = -1L,
  batch_axis = integer(0),
  dtype = NULL
)

nn_initializers_he_uniform(
  in_axis = -2L,
  out_axis = -1L,
  batch_axis = integer(0),
  dtype = NULL
)

nn_initializers_kaiming_uniform(
  in_axis = -2L,
  out_axis = -1L,
  batch_axis = integer(0),
  dtype = NULL
)

nn_initializers_he_normal(
  in_axis = -2L,
  out_axis = -1L,
  batch_axis = integer(0),
  dtype = NULL
)

nn_initializers_kaiming_normal(
  in_axis = -2L,
  out_axis = -1L,
  batch_axis = integer(0),
  dtype = NULL
)

nn_initializers_orthogonal(scale = 1, column_axis = -1L, dtype = NULL)

nn_initializers_delta_orthogonal(scale = 1, column_axis = -1L, dtype = NULL)

Arguments

key

A PRNG key (random_key() or random_PRNGKey()); ignored by the constant initializers.

shape

Integer vector.

dtype

Dtype (default float).

out_sharding

Accepted for compatibility (jaxR runs on one device); the orthogonal initializers require NULL.

value

Fill value.

scale

Upper bound of uniform, scaling factor of variance_scaling and orthogonal.

stddev

Standard deviation.

lower, upper

Truncation bounds of truncated_normal (in units of stddev).

mode

One of "fan_in", "fan_out", "fan_avg" and "fan_geo_avg".

distribution

One of "truncated_normal", "normal" and "uniform".

in_axis, out_axis, batch_axis

0-based axis or axes of the input dimension, the output dimension and the ignored (batch) dimensions of the weights.

column_axis

0-based axis holding the columns that should be orthogonal.

Value

An array (zeros, ones) or an initializer function.

Details

nn_initializers_variance_scaling draws from a (truncated) normal distribution with standard deviation sqrt(scale / n) or a uniform distribution with that standard deviation, where n is the number of inputs ("fan_in"), outputs ("fan_out"), their mean ("fan_avg") or their geometric mean ("fan_geo_avg"). Axes that are not input, output or batch axes form the receptive field of a convolution kernel. Complex dtypes draw from a disk ("uniform") or a truncated complex normal distribution. The Glorot (Xavier), LeCun and He (Kaiming) initializers are its specializations.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
init <- nn_initializers_glorot_normal()
init(random_key(42), c(2, 3))
nn_initializers_zeros(random_key(0), c(2, 2))
} # }
